opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: £56,000 in year one, £28,000 in years two and three (salary contribution), up to £6,000 per annum for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must not have held a full-time permanent academic post, must hold a doctorate, must have submitted their doctoral thesis for viva by the closing date, must not have more than four years of postdoctoral positions, and must meet residency and UK employment criteria.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work, providing salary contributions and research expenses.
discipline_tags: All disciplines except studies of disease, illness and disabilities in humans and animals, and research intended to inform clinical practice

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other UK higher‑education institutions, and on a trial basis UK‑based independent research institutes may apply. Applicants must be employed by the eligible institution and the institution must administer the grant.
opportunities.summary: Funds innovative and original research projects up to five years in length, covering staff costs and associated research expenses.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research, policy‑driven research, immediate commercial applications, data‑bank assembly, advocacy

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Application must be made by a UK university academic staff member (or specialist arts institution) who will coordinate the visit; the host institution must administer the grant.
opportunities.summary: Enables UK institutions to invite eminent overseas senior professors to deliver expertise, teaching, and research activities over a 3‑12 month period.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease, illness and disabilities in humans and animals, and research intended to inform clinical practice

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: Up to £1,000,000 for staff salaries and associated costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with a permanent UK university appointment (lecturer level or equivalent), at least two years post‑PhD experience, no prior leadership of a research team, and no previous award of comparable size.
opportunities.summary: Provides substantial funding to help early‑career researchers build and lead a modest research team, developing research leadership and delivering transformative research.
discipline_tags: All research areas except disease/clinical studies, policy‑driven evidence bases, advocacy, immediate commercial applications

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (single or collaborative) may apply; each university may submit one principal application but can act as a partner on multiple proposals.
opportunities.summary: Supports establishment of large‑scale research centres aiming for step‑change advances in scholarship, with multidisciplinary teams and substantial funding.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (subject to the Trust’s general exclusions of medical/clinical research and related areas)
